guide.summary: Garden houses, a cathedral, royal-style dinners, riverside hotel bars and breakfast rooms in Hue, each checked against its operator's own website.
guide.tip: None of the places checked lists a weekly closing day, but Phú Mộng takes a 50% deposit when you book and Hotel Saigon Morin's Royal Dinner needs at least 12 hours' notice, so arrange those ahead.

toolkit.label: Closing days
toolkit.copy: None of the places checked lists a weekly closing day: Madam Thu says it is open daily from 09:00 AM to 10:30 PM, and Vạn Xuân Bar at Ancient Hue opens daily from 5:00 PM.

toolkit.label: Tickets
toolkit.copy: An Hien Garden House listed a 50,000 VND entrance ticket and 8:00am–5:00pm opening on its owner Silk Path's page, last updated in January 2024.

toolkit.label: Booking
toolkit.copy: Phú Mộng at Ancient Hue requires a 50% deposit on booking for its Royal Package. Le Royal Restaurant at Hotel Saigon Morin is by advance reservation only, and the hotel's Royal Dinner needs at least 12 hours' notice.

toolkit.label: Walk-ins and diets
toolkit.copy: Vạn Xuân Bar welcomes guests who are not staying at Ancient Hue and takes last orders at 9:30 PM. Ancient Hue's restaurants adjust dishes for allergies or no pork if you tell them in advance.

guide.dek: Book Hue's royal-style dinners ahead, and fit An Hien Garden House into its listed 8:00am–5:00pm opening.
intro: This Hue guide is built from places whose own websites could be read, which means garden-house restaurants, riverside hotel dining rooms and one restored garden house. You can visit An Hien Garden House at 58 Nguyen Phuc Nguyen Street in Huong Long ward; its owner, Silk Path, listed opening from 8:00am to 5:00pm and a 50,000 VND ticket on a page last updated in January 2024. The Imperial City and royal tombs are not covered, because the conservation centre's website could not be read, so check their hours and prices with the site before you go.

In Kim Long, Ancient Hue gathers several dining rooms in one garden complex at 104/47 Kim Long. Kim Long Fine Dining has served guests since 2005 and offers an optional Royal Costume Dining Experience, while Phú Mộng stages a royal-style dinner that needs a 50% deposit when you book. For two, La Lune de Huế is a private glass-domed room, and Le Soleil de Huế serves French cooking with a Vietnamese touch. Vạn Xuân Bar opens daily from 5:00 PM, takes last orders at 9:30 PM and welcomes guests who are not staying.

Le Loi Street holds three hotels that make an easy evening circuit. At Azerai La Residence (5 Le Loi), Le Parfum serves Vietnamese and Western dishes for breakfast, lunch and dinner, and Le Gouverneur Bar is open from 8 a.m. to midnight. Silk Path Grand Hue (2 Le Loi) lists Nam Phuong for Hue cooking, with breakfast from 6:00 AM, and Olivio for European dishes at lunch and dinner. Hotel Saigon Morin (30 Le Loi) listed Le Panorama Bar, which overlooks the river and Truong Tien Bridge, as open 18:00–23:00 on a page dated 2020.

For a simpler meal, Madam Thu has two branches on Vo Thi Sau Street, at numbers 45 and 04, and says it is open daily from 09:00 AM to 10:30 PM. If you want Hue royal dishes in a hotel setting, Le Royal Restaurant at Hotel Saigon Morin takes guests by advance reservation only, and the hotel's Royal Dinner needs at least 12 hours' notice. Phu Cam Cathedral stands at 1 Doan Huu Trung Street, according to the Archdiocese of Hue's parish history.
summaryCards: Start at An Hien Garden House, listed at 8:00am–5:00pm with a 50,000 VND ticket on a January 2024 page, then eat at Madam Thu on Vo Thi Sau Street, which says it is open daily.
Silk Path Grand Hue's dining page lists breakfast at Nam Phuong from 6:00 to 10:00 AM, and the hotel's garden-facing Courtyard serves traditional Vietnamese coffee.
None of the places checked lists a weekly closing day, but Phú Mộng takes a 50% deposit and Hotel Saigon Morin's Royal Dinner needs at least 12 hours' notice.

limitations: Website review, not a visit or telephone confirmation. Advertised opening, booking and ticket details do not guarantee availability. The Hue Monuments Conservation Centre site (Imperial City, royal tombs, Royal Antiquities Museum) refused connection and its e-ticket portal showed no readable content, so the city's main heritage sights are absent; the Ho Chi Minh Museum site returned nothing readable, Bach Ma National Park had a certificate error, and Meliá Vinpearl Hue, Huong Giang Hotel, Highlands Coffee and Starbucks returned 403. Many Hue cafés and bakeries publish only on social media, which this review does not accept, so coffee and bakery coverage is limited to hotel lounges. Hotel Saigon Morin's hours come from listings dated September 2020, An Hien Garden House's hours and ticket price from a page updated January 2024, and Silk Path's dining hours from an undated page; Madam Thu, Phú Mộng, Le Soleil and Vạn Xuân show only a 2026 copyright as current evidence. Ancient Hue's restaurants and Phu Cam Cathedral publish no opening hours. The confirmed total (18) is below the 25–35 target because few Hue venues have readable official websites.
